# What Vivado 2026.1 made of each design here, on xc7a100tftg256-3, from
# tools/vivado-parity/ffpack.sh: each slice holding a held flip-flop (`r*`),
# its bitstream decoded through this repository's database. `slice` is the
# site's type and its features of no lane; `lane` lines are its four lanes,
# A to D. tests/fpga_xray_ffpack_vivado.rs says how to read one.
design async8
  slice SLICEL CEUSEDMUX SRUSEDMUX
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zrst,ff5.zini
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zrst,ff5.zini
design ctrl8
  slice SLICEL CEUSEDMUX FFSYNC SRUSEDMUX
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zrst,ff5.zini
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zrst
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zini
design free16
  slice SLICEL FFSYNC
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
  slice SLICEL FFSYNC
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
design free8
  slice SLICEL FFSYNC
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
design free8m
  slice SLICEM FFSYNC
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
design lut2x16
  slice SLICEL FFSYNC
    lane ff=O5 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through5+2 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
    lane ff=O5 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through5+2 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
    lane ff=O5 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through5+2 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
    lane ff=O5 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through5+2 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
  slice SLICEL FFSYNC
    lane ff=O5 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through5+2 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
    lane ff=O5 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through5+2 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
    lane ff=O5 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through5+2 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
    lane ff=O5 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through5+2 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst

    lane ff=O5 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through5+4 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst

design mixed_ce
  slice SLICEL CEUSEDMUX FFSYNC
    lane ff=LX ff5=- out=- lut=- init=ff.zini,ff.zrst
    lane ff=- ff5=- out=- lut=- init=-
    lane ff=- ff5=- out=- lut=- init=-
    lane ff=- ff5=- out=- lut=- init=-
  slice SLICEM FFSYNC
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
    lane ff=- ff5=- out=- lut=- init=-
    lane ff=- ff5=- out=- lut=- init=-
    lane ff=- ff5=- out=- lut=- init=-
  slice SLICEM FFSYNC
    lane ff=- ff5=- out=- lut=- init=-
    lane ff=LX ff5=- out=- lut=- init=ff.zini,ff.zrst
    lane ff=- ff5=- out=- lut=- init=-
    lane ff=- ff5=- out=- lut=- init=-
  slice SLICEM FFSYNC
    lane ff=LX ff5=- out=- lut=- init=ff.zini,ff.zrst
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
    lane ff=- ff5=- out=- lut=- init=-
    lane ff=- ff5=- out=- lut=- init=-
  slice SLICEM FFSYNC
    lane ff=- ff5=- out=- lut=- init=-
    lane ff=- ff5=- out=- lut=- init=-
    lane ff=LX ff5=- out=- lut=- init=ff.zini,ff.zrst
    lane ff=- ff5=- out=- lut=- init=-
  slice SLICEM FFSYNC
    lane ff=LX ff5=- out=- lut=- init=ff.zini,ff.zrst
    lane ff=- ff5=- out=- lut=- init=-
    lane ff=- ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=- init=ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
    lane ff=- ff5=- out=- lut=- init=-
  slice SLICEM FFSYNC
    lane ff=LX ff5=- out=- lut=- init=ff.zini,ff.zrst
    lane ff=LX ff5=- out=- lut=- init=ff.zini,ff.zrst
    lane ff=- ff5=- out=- lut=- init=-
    lane ff=LX ff5=- out=- lut=- init=ff.zini,ff.zrst
  slice SLICEM FFSYNC
    lane ff=LX ff5=- out=- lut=- init=ff.zini,ff.zrst
    lane ff=- ff5=- out=- lut=- init=-
    lane ff=- ff5=- out=- lut=- init=-
    lane ff=- ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=- init=ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
design two_clocks
  slice SLICEL FFSYNC
    lane ff=LX ff5=- out=- lut=- init=ff.zini,ff.zrst
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
    lane ff=O6 ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=through6 init=ff.zini,ff.zrst,ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
  slice SLICEL FFSYNC
    lane ff=- ff5=IN_B out=L5Q lut=- init=ff5.zini,ff5.zrst
    lane ff=- ff5=- out=- lut=- init=-
    lane ff=- ff5=- out=- lut=- init=-
    lane ff=- ff5=- out=- lut=- init=-
